objective: Install BOTH measured ingredients of the decomposition-adjoint defect (freestreamVelocity farfield + a cellLimited U-convection scheme) on the clean structured NACA0012 and measure whether the case ACQUIRES the defect under np=4 scotch
rationale: The robustness campaign (DEFECT_ROBUSTNESS_mesh_and_setup.md, 2026-08-05/07) reduced the trigger to a conjunction: a branch-carrying recorded computation (slope limiter min/max, R6b one-word lever 8.95 percent to 0.849 percent with the operator cross-residual collapsing 24,300-fold; freestreamVelocity flux switch, N9) times a cut that excites its reverse sweep. Every within-case control lives on the one Ahmed background mesh; the mirror arm R1 (BC alone on A1) was null exactly as the conjunction predicts because A1's scheme is unlimited. One arm now separates 'the conjunction is the trigger' from 'the Ahmed mesh family carries something else': A1 with the freestream BC (R1's staged edit, already scripted) plus div(phi,U) bounded Gauss linearUpwind limited with a cellLimited gradScheme entry, np=1 and np=4 scotch, check_totals; cross-residual via the discriminators instrument if it fires. Fires: the defect finally has a second independent mesh family and the upstream report's reproducer is mesh-agnostic. Stays clean: the Ahmed family or its loose primalMinResTol 1e-4 (the confound R3b could not close, recorded) carries a necessary co-ingredient, and the report must scope to that.
gate: Either the A1+BC+limiter arm reads >= 2 percent against its own FD under np=4 scotch with its np=1 control clean (defect acquired; cross-residual run and cited), or it reads <= 0.5 percent at both (conjunction insufficient off the Ahmed family) -- both outcomes decisive, prediction pre-registered before the first run.
cost_basis: measured this campaign: A1 check_totals arms cost 2.6-3.1 core-min each at --cpus=2; a fired-defect crossres protocol on a 26k-state case costs ~13 core-min (upw/io levers, ledgered); reserve for one FD step-check
expected_knowledge_gain: Decides whether the branch-conjunction trigger is mesh-family-agnostic, which is the difference between an upstream report that says 'any case with a limited scheme and a freestream BC is exposed under scotch' and one that says 'we have one exposed mesh family'. Also the cheapest remaining probe of the open primalMinResTol confound: A1 runs at 1e-8, so a fired defect there kills the loose-primal co-ingredient hypothesis in the same run.
